summary: The Blackout fade at *(00E198C4 + A4h) + C0h, its per-frame update, and the completion callback that re-enters the mission script by name. corrections.was: docs/LUA_BINDING_MISSION.md: the fade object's `+C8h` holds `duration + [00D7A268]`, and 'nothing in this process advances that object'.
corrections.is: +C8h is the seconds remaining, not a deadline. 00D7A268 is the double 1.0e-4, an epsilon so a zero duration still arms. 005B9800 decrements it by the step, and the native advance is 004C40F0 at 004C429A through the screen's vtable +20h. The executable did not advance it because the binding was a record, not because the routine was missing.

corrections.was: docs/LUA_BINDING_MISSION.md follow-up 2: `ingame_movie_listener`, the camera-movie completion that calls luaIngameMovie's cb, is 'the second gate, immediately after the first'.
corrections.is: There is no native camera-movie completion. commandhelpers.lua:7728 ends luaCamIngameMovieAuto with luaDelay(luaCamOnTargetExt, callbackTime, "CB", callback, ...), so the completion is the already reconstructed delayed-call scheduler and the think walk 00929460. AddListener("input", "IngameMovieInputListenerID") is only the skip-with-a-button path, and IsListenerActive answering false makes luaCamOnTargetExt skip the RemoveListener. A headless run satisfies it, and did.
corrections.evidence: commandhelpers.lua:7719-7732 and 7824-7856; the run fired luaIntroMovieEnd 19 simulated seconds after luaIngameMovieBOStart.

corrections.was: docs/INTERFACE_RUNTIME_TAIL.md: the Blackout_Icon widget has two virtuals, set-visible +34h and set-colour +50h.
corrections.is: Three. 005B99C9 calls +54h to read the colour back before the level is written into its alpha and +50h writes it again.

corrections.was: The vtable that carries 005BC920 is 00CF0ED4 (the address 005B917E and 005BABD7 store).
corrections.is: 00CF0ED4 is a different, one-slot vtable belonging to the class those two routines build. The HUD narrative screen's own vtable is 00CF0ED8, stored at 005BA7EF, and the derived slots line up with the base table in docs/FRONTEND_STATE_MACHINE.md only under that base: +20h update, +24h collect children.

follow_ups.why: FindEntity returns nil, so Mission.EscapePoint, Mission.Witte and 36 other lookups are nil. It is the single gate between the current run and phase 2's victory test.
GetHpPercentage answers 0, so phase 1 closed on De Ruyter being 'destroyed'. The transition is real but the reason is wrong.
The other four sub-updates of the screen's per-frame pass, and the four child screens it forces visible.
